patterns.rsi2_pullback: close>MA200; MA200 rising over20 sessions; RSI2<10
patterns.pocket_pivot: close>prior high and MA50>MA200; volume>maximum prior10 down-day volume
patterns.strong_flag: 20-session gain ending D-4>=15%; D-4 to D-1 return -8..0%; close>prior high and open
patterns.volume_climax_recovery: prior day volume>=2 prior20 and TR>=2 previous ATR, close in bottom quarter; today holds prior low and closes above prior midpoint/open/MA200
patterns.anchored_vwap_reclaim: anchor at highest-volume prior20 bar, volume>=2 its prior20 mean; price crosses fixed-anchor typical-price VWAP; close>MA200, volume>=1.2 prior20
patterns.regression_reclaim: prior60 causal trend residual z crosses from<=-2 yesterday to>-1 today; close>open and MA200
patterns.higher_low_breakout: last two confirmed 2+2 pivots have rising highs and lows; first close above last confirmed high; above MA200; volume>=1.2
patterns.breakout_acceptance: D-5 first closes above prior20 high; five later closes hold fixed level; current close within8% above level and aboveMA200
patterns.obv_leads_price: OBV made a20-session high in last5 while price below20 high; close now crosses prior5 high aboveMA200; OBV rises over5
patterns.ma_cross_first_pullback: MA20 crosses aboveMA50 in prior10; first subsequent MA20 touch with bullish reclaim; aboveMA200
patterns.breadth_followthrough: same-day watchlist breadth aboveMA20>=50%, same members five sessions ago<=30%, at least10 paired names; QQQ3>1%; stock aboveMA20/MA200, volume>=1.2

filters.up_volume_dominates: prior/current5 up-day volume>=1.5 down-day volume and some down volume
filters.resistance_room: at least2 ATR below prior60 high OR already above prior60 high
filters.above_vwap20: close>rolling20 typical-price volume-weighted average (daily, not intraday VWAP)
filters.broad_participation: at least10 watched names and >=50% aboveMA20 on signal date
filters.rs_vs_watchlist: 20-session stock return>median same-day watched stock return; at least10 names
filters.down_day_resilience: mean stock-minus-QQQ daily return on prior/current20 QQQ down-days>0; at least5 matched days

exit_modes.common: D+1 open; close -8/+12/20 + market; next open
exit_modes.ma20_failure: common + after first close>=MA20, two consecutive closes below MA20 trigger next open exit
exit_modes.signal_low_failure: common + two closes below frozen signal-day low trigger next open exit
exit_modes.half_at6: common + sell half next open after +6% close; rest original; proportional total .4% cost

context: watchlist, NOT whole-market breadth; same members on D and D-5; >=10 observations; no unknown->false performance comparison
status: exploratory follow-up on already-seen data; no threshold optimization; all tested candidates reported
price: 2026 observed watchlist;2021-25 current survivors; no actual event state/portfolio replication
